name: Magnetic Materials
summary: Covers the origins of magnetism in solids and the soft and hard magnetic materials used in motors, transformers, data storage and sensors.

topics.name: Magnetic field quantities: H, B, M, susceptibility and permeability
Atomic origin of magnetic moments; diamagnetism and paramagnetism
Ferromagnetism, antiferromagnetism and ferrimagnetism; exchange interaction and Curie temperature
Magnetic anisotropy: magnetocrystalline, shape and stress anisotropy
Domains, domain walls and the magnetisation process; hysteresis
Soft magnetic materials: electrical steels, Ni-Fe (permalloy), ferrites, amorphous and nanocrystalline alloys
Core losses: hysteresis and eddy-current losses
Hard (permanent) magnets: alnico, hard ferrites, SmCo and NdFeB; energy product (BH)max
Rare-earth supply issues and rare-earth-free magnet research
Magnetic recording and spintronic materials (GMR, TMR, MRAM)
